name: ModalFooter

props.name: danger
props.description: Specify an optional function that is called whenever the modal is closed / closeModal?(evt: MouseEvent): void; /** Specify whether the primary button should be replaced with danger button. Note that this prop is not applied if you render primary/danger button by yourself

props.name: dangerDescription
props.description: Specify the message read by screen readers for the danger primary button. Defaults to an empty string; provide localized text to opt in.

props.name: inputref
props.description: The `ref` callback for the primary button.

props.name: loadingDescription
props.description: Specify the description for the loading text

props.name: loadingIconDescription
props.description: Specify the description for the loading text

props.name: primaryButtonDisabled
props.description: Specify an optional function for when the modal is requesting to be closed / onRequestClose?(): void; /** Specify an optional function for when the modal is requesting to be submitted / onRequestSubmit?(): void; /** Specify whether the primary button should be disabled

props.name: primaryButtonText
props.description: Specify the text for the primary button

props.name: primaryClassName
props.description: Specify a custom className to be applied to the primary button

props.name: secondaryButtonText
props.description: Specify the text for the secondary button

props.name: secondaryButtons
props.description: Specify an array of config objects for secondary buttons

props.name: secondaryClassName
props.description: Specify a custom className to be applied to the secondary button

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ModalFooter rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
